description: This file defines the Signable class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling cryptographic signing operations related to HTTP requests, chunks, and canonical requests. It extends a NativeResource and provides factory methods to create Signable objects from different types of data inputs.

classes.name: Signable
classes.description: Represents a signable cryptographic object that can be created from HTTP requests, chunks, or canonical requests, and manages resources related to signing operations.

methods.name: fromHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from an HTTP request message.

methods.name: fromChunk
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from a data chunk stream, with an optional previous signature.

methods.name: fromCanonicalRequest
methods.description: Creates a Signable object from a canonical request string.
